BiblicalUsage: Paul says the reward of the inheritance is what believers receive from the Lord, the recompense for serving Christ. The word names the repayment itself, the act of giving back.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for a reward holds no doctrine of its own; its comfort is Paul's, that serving Christ carries an inheritance as its recompense.
